name: anna solves
overview:
The girl who solves....

Each episode, I break down what happened, how it unfolded, and why it still matters  because behind every headline is a real person, a real family, and a wound that doesn't just disappear when the news cycle moves on. From cold cases cracked open by a single strand of DNA, to serial killers who fooled everyone around them, to wrongful convictions that stole decades from innocent people, to the quiet neighborhoods where the most unthinkable things happened behind closed doors. The timeline inconsistencies. The witnesses nobody followed up with. The evidence that sat in a box for twenty years and The moments where the system failed and nobody said a word.

Every victim deserves more than a two-minute segment and a file number  Hit subscribe, turn on notifications so you never miss a case and join me as we solve these stories together. THANKS!
